description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Greenwarden of Murasa
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
